# Dependency lifecycle (EG-DEP-001)

Native Dependabot owns routine updates for registered workloads, fixtures, reference Cargo workspace, Maven reactors, Go actionlint module, Dockerfiles, Compose images and immutable workflow actions. `.github/dependency-update-policy.json` records exact current declaration paths and finite review constraints. The structural validator uses Mike Farah yq v4 (provided in the current hosted runner image) and the tracked Git tree. Local validation requires yq on PATH. A native-managed manifest's newly generated lock/checksum companion inherits its verified ownership; new primary declarations must have explicit ownership. No workload subject, benchmark graph or provider artifact was advanced by this change.

Security/cache binaries use the immutable Dependabot-managed taiki-e/install-action release with checksum enabled and fallback disabled. Embedded manifests follow upstream with a deliberate short supply-chain cooldown; the actual selected release must pass positive and negative checks. Both protected-main cache families incorporate actual installed sccache version, binary digest, runner OS version and existing compiler/lock identity. New producer evidence and real restore-only use remain required after migration. No unverified archive fallback or write-enabled PR cache.

Latest native GA Ubuntu ARM64 has no moving alias. Its exact label is a finite reviewed constraint; move all coupled paths in a PR on a new provider GA. Historical benchmark evidence remains tied to its original environment. The exact actionlint label recognition exception expires on upstream support or review deadline. Java 25 benchmark and Java 11 adapter compatibility, published OxideBatch subjects, benchmark comparison inputs and paired provider release/schema/API provenance remain explicit reviewed constraints. Native update PRs are candidates, not proof of compatibility. See #371 and EG #28/#32.
